description: List Lambda layers available in the account.

compatible_architecture.description: Optional architecture, such as x86_64 or arm64, to filter layers by compatibility, sent as CompatibleArchitecture.

compatible_runtime.description: Optional runtime, such as nodejs20.x, to filter layers by compatibility, sent as CompatibleRuntime.

max_items.description: Optional maximum number of layers to return, sent as the MaxItems query parameter.

name: list_layers
